correctness.rationale: Complete genus-one degree-three embedding argument reduces every cover to a depressed plane cubic, and PGL2 transitivity reduces six rational branch points to the separable sextic X^6-Y^6. Both exact standalone programs fully enumerate the 823543 choices and agree on twelve models and two fixed-base equivalence classes. The target swap proves uniqueness after base automorphisms; explicit derivative and rational-root arguments establish smoothness, branch behavior and 13 points. The proof does not use finite samples as an infinite claim.

value.rationale: For a tame elliptic trigonal map, six distinct branch points are the maximal simple branch count by Riemann–Hurwitz. With only eight target rational points, the all-six-rational branch condition is canonical up to base automorphism. The theorem completely classifies the corresponding small arithmetic Hurwitz fiber, distinguishes fixed-target from unmarked classes, and forces an elliptic source attaining the Hasse upper bound 13. It is a natural complete classification not an unmotivated slice.
